reading_log.notes: Read complete references pp10–12; checked cited identities/years and canonical title variants, including PARCO, SLIM, ATT-GCN, POMO, MatNet, Gumbeldore, DIMES and DIFUSCO. No automatic citation edges; final mapping awaits remaining reference page.

Read final references, Proposition1 normalization proof and policy architecture. Proposition1 uses nonempty remaining feasible pair sets at every sampled history; general bipartite greedy choices need not retain a complete matching, so distinguish local stochastic normalization from an unconditional feasible-completion theorem. Read FJSP definition and MILP notation.

Read all scheduling and HCVRP mathematical formulations and MDP mappings. Scheduling assigns next operations earliest-feasible with precedence/machine masks; minmax HCVRP minimizes maximum vehicle travel cost under capacity and once-only service, rather than total tour length. FFSP formal printed predecessor notation and nonlinear max constraints are descriptive formulation, not an extra proven algorithm guarantee.

Read benchmark generalization Tables5–8, full skip-token training dynamics and scalability/profiling. Best-performing trained-size model is selected per public benchmark; MACSIM sampling best among neural comparators but OR-Tools remains best for all four public groups. MatNet memory numbers are measured with batch1, while training times use method-specific maximum batch sizes. Multi-action reduces neural evaluations, but its sequential sampler still has cost (125–156ms versus SLIM120–121ms).

Read complete loss-gradient analysis and Theorem2/proof. Row-wise softmax cross-entropy target-logit derivative p−1 does not vanish as p→0, contrary to broad vanishing-gradient prose. Theorem2 bounds unordered matching NLL under its explicitly defined exogenous permutation-prior plus row-conditional sampler; this is not automatically the global pair-softmax generative mechanism Eq3, and is not solution optimality or convergence. Its RHS sum log(1+r) equals LCE, with near-certain-row tightness conditional on each expert pair staying available.

Read shared-parameter coordination argument and raw-conflict visualizations; they support an empirical mechanism, not an injectivity guarantee from independent loss. Read all problem-specific training settings, datasets, hardware/software and LLM disclosure. FJSP/FFSP/HCVRP train separate models (README explicitly disallows cross-family evaluation), so specialist. Each run one A10080GB; scaling experiment earlier uses40GB. FFSP AppendixH.2 prose mentions machines6/8/10 whereas Table6 actually4/6/8; report evaluated table values.
